simple.summary: זֶרֶשׁ (Zeresh) means Zeresh , Haman's wife First listed occurrence: Esth 5 10.

definitions.full: H2238. Zeresh זֶ֫רֶשׁ proper name, feminine wife of Haman Est 5:10 , 14 ; 6:13 (twice in verse) (according to Opp Esth. 25 = Persian zaris , Zend zairis , la dorée , compare aurum ductile , Vull ii. 128 b ; Jen VOJ, 1892, 64 compare Elamite goddess Kiriša ).
